_schema: mchatai-source/verbs/ios/_nouns.json — the typed things that flow between verbs on the person's iPhone or iPad (Phase AV.0, 2026-11-09). A verb's `inputs` and `outputs` name these; an argument may carry `noun` to say the string refers to one of them. Every noun a write produces is openable (invariant R1, docs/APPLET_VERB_SCOPING.md). Design: mchatai_macOS/docs/IOS_AGENT_SKILLS_PLAN.md §3.

Text.summary: Plain text or Markdown with no home of its own yet: a summary, a script, an extract.

Document.summary: A document in AI Write on this device.

WebPage.summary: A web page that was read: its address, title and visible text.

Paper.summary: One item from a research source: a paper, a preprint, a post. `source` names the source pack it came from.

Episode.summary: An episode in the Podcasts library on this device.

Transcript.summary: Spoken words written down, with the language they were spoken in.

Source.summary: A place to search: a source pack from mchatai-source/sources or one the person added (My sources).

File.summary: A file on this device the person picked: audio to transcribe, a PDF to read.

Agent.summary: An agent the person made on this device: a name, its steps and the sources it searches. Opened by switching to it in the chat.
